recommended_task: RUL Benchmarking / Sequence Modeling / Degradation Prediction
limitations: Simulated data — not real sensor data. No vibration. Aerospace domain — requires domain adaptation for industrial/textile. RUL labels available directly. 4 sub-datasets (FD001–FD004) with different fault modes and operating conditions. Standard PHM benchmark.

source: NASA / University of Cincinnati IMS Center
limitations: No direct RUL labels — must be computed from run-to-failure timestamps. 4 bearings per run. 3 experimental runs. File size ~6 GB. Vibration at 20 kHz. Not real factory data but widely validated benchmark.

dataset_name: FEMTO / PRONOSTIA Bearing Accelerated Life Test
recommended_task: RUL / Degradation Prognostics / Bearing Accelerated Life
limitations: Accelerated life tests — not realistic operating conditions. Small dataset (~17 bearings). RUL labels computable. Used in IEEE PHM 2012 Challenge. Well-documented degradation trajectories.

dataset_name: Paderborn Bearing Data Center — KAt Bearing Dataset
recommended_task: Fault Classification / Feature Learning / Anomaly Detection
limitations: Primarily diagnostic dataset — not run-to-failure. Contains artificially damaged bearings + real damaged bearings. Very large (~10 GB). Contains current + vibration + temperature — good for multi-modal feature learning. NOT suitable as primary RUL dataset.

dataset_name: PHM Society 2009 Challenge — Gearbox Fault Detection
limitations: No run-to-failure data. Accelerometer + tachometer only. Limited to 4 fault classes. Small dataset. Useful for gearbox fault characterization and complementary feature learning.

dataset_name: PHM Society Data Repository — Multiple Challenges
limitations: Aggregated repository — dataset quality and format varies. Requires per-dataset investigation. Licenses vary. Good for discovering specialized datasets.

dataset_name: MAINTIX Synthetic Industrial Telemetry — Textile Machines
recommended_task: Domain-Specific Training / Textile Adaptation / RL Environment
limitations: Synthetic data generated from simulator. Not validated on real machines. Required for domain adaptation until real ESP32/industrial data is available from pilot factory. Ground truth labels are simulated.
